visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with isometric gameplay footage of a mobile MOBA game. A stylized female character with white hair and a blue dress is moving along a grassy path near a river. She casts a magical ability that spawns a glowing blue circular pattern on the ground, adorned with celestial motifs. The environment features lush green terrain and stone pathways. (2) The scene transitions into a high-quality 3D CGI animation. A female character with light blue hair, blue eyes, and a white bow is shown floating in a dreamlike sky filled with pastel pink and blue clouds. A white fluffy mascot character with large ears and a blue bow (Cinnamoroll) flies alongside her. Glittering magical trails follow their movements. (3) The perspective shifts back to the isometric game view to demonstrate the character's combat mechanics. The character fires blue glowing projectiles as auto-attacks and activates a defensive skill that creates a translucent blue bubble shield. The lighting is bright and saturated, typical of vibrant digital animation. (4) The final phase showcases the character's 'ultimate' ability. A massive, circular blue area appears on the map, filled with intricate decorations including floating cakes, desserts, and large Cinnamoroll icons. The character performs an emote involving sweets and a tea party theme before the video ends on a close-up of the CGI model.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 傳說對決造型公道帝 大耳狗聯動造型搶先看. (2) [Subtitle]: 等一下. (3) [Subtitle]: 這個造型也太過看了吧. (4) [Subtitle]: 上次才剛介紹完庫洛米. (5) [Subtitle]: 現在馬上又來一個大耳狗. (6) [Subtitle]: 王者榮耀最近的聯動真的是非常的有料. (7) [Subtitle]: 那聯動的對象呢 對應到王者榮耀裡面的瑤這個英雄. (8) [Subtitle]: 那與之呼應的呢 就是傳說對決的芽芽. (9) [Subtitle]: 不得不說這個造型做的真的太卡哇伊了. (10) [Subtitle]: 喜歡嗎 底下留言爸爸買給你. (11) [Subtitle]: 那這個造型呢 無論是普攻 無論是被動 123技能. (12) [Subtitle]: 通通充斥著大耳狗的味道. (13) [Subtitle]: 大招開下去 彷彿來到三麗鷗的世界. (14) [Subtitle]: 那各位覺得這個造型怎麼樣呢 你們喜歡嗎. (15) [Subtitle]: 我講坦白的 我沒有很喜歡 甚至非常的害怕. (16) [Subtitle]: 我害怕這個造型如果來傳說對決 整個戰場會一堆芽芽. (17) [Subtitle]: 底下留言區標記你的朋友 讓他們一起來看這個造型. (18) [Subtitle]: 男生們注意啊 女朋友們一定會很喜歡. (19) [Subtitle]: 可惜正在看影片的你 沒有女朋友.
